recipient: Foundation for National Parks and Wildlife
project_description: The project supports wildlife rehabilitators to rescue, treat and rehabilitate wildlife impacted by bushfires: to help rebuild, improve, or create new major wildlife care infrastructure; and undertake actions to build capacity and preparedness to respond to future emergencies.

recipient: Royal Zoological Society of South Australia Incorporated (Zoos SA)
project_title: Emergency wildlife support and building threatened species capacity in response to wildfire
project_description: The project supports emergency rescue and veterinary treatment of bushfire-affected animals, supplementary feeding targeting Kangaroo Island Dunnarts and emergency interventions to support threatened species on Kangaroo Island. The project also includes construction of a new small animal breeding facility at Monarto Safari Park.

project_title: Taronga Zoo wildlife rescue and rehabilitation
project_description: The project involves emergency rescue and veterinary treatment of bushfire-affected wildlife; enhancement of the capacity of Taronga wildlife hospitals; an e-learning veterinary module; a purpose-built mobile app to support emergency in-situ resource supplementation for native wildlife; construction of a holding aviary for Regent Honeyeater and a specialist breeding facility for Northern Corroboree Frog; assessment of how bushfires alter the availability of tree hollows for wildlife and the usefulness of nest boxes to provide habitat; and investigation of emerging infectious diseases in bushfire-affected native wildlife.

recipient: Zoological Parks and Gardens Board (Zoos Vic)
project_title: Zoos Victoria bushfire emergency wildlife response
project_description: The project is supporting the construction of new and upgraded multi-species holding pens and construction of specialist facilities for captive breeding of Spotted Tree Frog, Large Brown Frog and Giant Burrowing Frog. It also involves emergency rescue and veterinary treatment of bushfire-affected animals, providing training and support to native wildlife rehabilitators, and in-situ emergency interventions to support the Alpine She-oak Skink and Spotted Tree Frog.

recipient: National Trust of Australia (Queensland) Limited (trading as Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary)
project_description: The project will maintain and expand an existing Eastern Bristlebird conservation breeding program.

recipient: National Trust of Australia (Queensland) Limited (trading as Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary)
project_description: The project will maintain and expand an existing Kroombit Tinkerfrog conservation breeding program to provide for increased breeding and a greater number of wild releases.

recipient: Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Queensland Ltd (trading as RSPCA Qld)
project_title: Wildlife and Koala Bushfire Recovery and Preparedness Program
project_description: The project will enhance capacity and preparedness to respond to future bushfires by increasing capability to rescue and treat native wildlife, including rehabilitating and re-introducing into suitable environments.

recipient: The Trustee for Gowland Family Trust (trading as Priam Psittaculture Centre)
project_description: The project will expand two existing captive breeding programs–the Koonoom Smoky Mouse and New Holland Mouse–and build on successful work previously achieved with reintroductions for these species.

recipient: Matim Pty Ltd (trading as Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Conservation Park)
project_title: New Holland Mouse and other Pseudomys Recovery and Restoration
project_description: The project will establish captive populations of New Holland Mouse and Smoky Mouse for release into suitably restored and protected habitats.

recipient: Trustee for The Gerald and Catherine Barnard Family Trust (trading as Australia Walkabout Wildlife Park Pty Ltd)
project_title: Walkabout Wildlife Sanctuary Brush-tailed Rock-wallaby Semi-wild Breed for Release Program
project_description: The project will establish a breeding and hardening facility, to support an existing Brush-tailed Rock-wallaby breed-for-release program.

project_title: Manning River Helmeted Turtle Breeding Facility
project_description: This project will establish a new conservation breeding program for the endangered Manning River Helmeted Turtle to bolster natural populations and complement existing breeding program for this species.

project_title: Brush-tailed Rock-wallaby, Manning River Helmeted Turtle, Giant Barred Frog and Stuttering Frog
project_description: The project will expand existing conservation breeding programs for the Brush-tailed Rock-wallaby and the Manning River Helmeted Turtle; and establish new conservation breeding programs for the Giant Barred Frog and the Stuttering Frog.

project_title: Buying time & Restoring Populations: Managing collaborative conservation breeding programs
project_description: The project is supporting captive breeding and research to captively-bred species, provide advice on appropriate species management practices and communicate the outcomes of the captive breeding programs.

recipient: J.M.R. Pty Limited (business name Symbio Wildlife Park)
project_title: Saving the Georges Snapping Turtle (aka Bellinger River Snapping Turtle), Manning River Helmeted Turtle and Stuttering Frog
project_description: This project will establish new conservation breeding programs for the Manning River Helmeted Turtle and the Stuttering Frog and expand an existing conservation breeding program for the Georges Snapping Turtle.

project_title: Expansion and capacity building in recovery of critically endangered Regent Honeyeater and Bellinger River Snapping Turtle
project_description: The project will expand the existing conservation breeding programs for the Regent Honeyeater and Bellinger River Snapping Turtle at Taronga Zoo.

recipient: Zoological Parks and Gardens Board (trading as Zoos Victoria)
project_title: Emergency rescue and captive facilities for the critically endangered Mountain Pygmy-possum
project_description: The project will construct a new alpine-mimicking, Mountain Pygmy-possum facility at Healesville Sanctuary to enhance preparedness for future catastrophic events and enable expansion of the current captive breeding and research program.

project_title: Assessing the genetic value of Koala populations for conservation prioritisation
project_description: The project will sequence the genomes of 400 individual koalas across New South Wales, Queensland and Victoria. The genetic data produced will help prioritise the on-ground management of koala populations and/or translocations to preserve unique genetic profiles in-situ and in captive breeding programs.

recipient: The Trustee for National Threatened Species Trust
project_description: The project will establish a captive breeding population for Eastern Ground Parrots–also to be used as an analogue species for the Western Ground Parrot–and establish a captive breeding population for Hastings River Mouse.

project_title: Genetic management of bushfire recovery species
project_description: The project will assist other captive breeding initiatives by using the latest genome sequencing technologies to assess genetic diversity, inbreeding and relatedness amongst individuals within captive breeding programs and provide breeding and/or translocation recommendations.
